findings.one_line: The 2^p-state DAG enumerates compatible orders only; it does not deliver the promised output-sensitive, exact-once enumeration of distinct coefficient tuples, which the core expressly leaves unclaimed.

The bibliography retains the quotient-enumeration comparators (Guo--Perkovic, Wienobst et al., Wang et al., Avis--Fukuda), but the current related-work and comparator table give them no relevance sentence after the enumeration theorem was dropped; either position the residual open problem or remove the stale citations.
